source_sql: WITH anchors AS (SELECT a.node_id FROM Section a JOIN edge own ON own.src_id=a.node_id AND own.rel_type='BELONGS_TO_SPEC' JOIN Spec edition ON edition.node_id=own.dst_id JOIN edge family ON family.src_id=edition.node_id AND family.rel_type='IN_RELEASE_OF' JOIN Spec hub ON hub.node_id=family.dst_id WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL AND hub.specNumber='38.211' AND a.sectionNumber='5.2.1') SELECT DISTINCT source.sectionId AS sectionId FROM anchors a JOIN edge ref ON ref.dst_id=a.node_id AND ref.rel_type='REFERENCES_SECTION' JOIN Section source ON source.node_id=ref.src_id
